modules.name: Begynne here
modules.description:
# Welcome to DraconDex

This foldere is a smalle worlde that worketh in sooth. All that is withinne is trewe matere: open it, chaunge it, and do it awey whan thou art done. The booke shal never chaunge it of its owne wille.

**One Parte = one Werke.** Eche thynge in this foldere is a Parte of a dyvers kynde. Open eche in turne to see wherefore it serveth.

- [[Personnes]] — a kynde with feeldes. Every rowe is a thynge thou mayst lynke unto.
- [[Who knoweth whom]] — sheweth the personnes and how they be knytte.
- [[Mappe of the Havene]] — a mappe with landes.
- [[Chronycle]] — a rolle of dated happenynges.
- [[Wanderynges]] — pynnes on the mappe tyed to happenynges.
- [[The Metynge]] — a speche that brancheth.
- [[The Fyrste Booke]] — chapiters, a wrytyng table, and a borde of corke.
- [[Notes of the Sittynge]] — notes after the manere of speche.
- [[Rumoures]] — a table of chaunce: presse Castyth.
- [[Draught of the Havene]] — a leef for drawynge by hande.
- [[Plotte of the Tale]] — a free figure of boxes and arwes.
- [[Of Mira]] — one leef of one thynge.

**Lynkes.** Wryte `[[` wheresoever to lynke unto any thynge by name — as the lynkes on this leef. The thynge so lynked sheweth this leef amonge its Bakklynks.

**Fynde all thynges.** Presse Ctrl+P to fynde a Parte, a thynge, a lyne of wrytyng, or a commaundement.

**Begynne thyne owne.** Use + in the Nest, or "Forgyth a Werke fromme a Patterne" for a hole werke at one strooke.

modules.name: Personnes
modules.description: A Classifier is a kynde: a rolle of thynges that sharen feeldes. Clicke a thynge to open it; adde a feelde with + under its feeldes. A feelde may be wrytyng, a nombre, a chesyng, a boxe to tycke, a lynke to anothir thynge, or a reckenynge.

objects.name: Mira
objects.note: Maister of the *Gulle*. Oweth [[Tobin]] a favour she hath not spoken of.

objects.name: Tobin
objects.note: A clerke that redeth olde chartes.

objects.name: Sela
objects.note: Knoweth every bakke dore of the havene.

modules.name: Who knoweth whom
modules.description: An Exhibitor sheweth the matere of othir Partes — here, the Personnes. It owneth nothynge: to do it awey loseth but the ordynaunce. Assaye the Graph, Table and Board vyewes, and the ordre of lynage on the Frende feelde.

modules.name: Mappe of the Havene
modules.description: A Locator is a mappe. Adde landes and poyntes, and lynke them to any thynge in the Nexvs.

modules.name: Chronycle
modules.description: A Chronicler is a rolle of tyme. Every happenynge hath a daye; the kalender may be thyne owne worldes.

events.name: The havene is founded
events.story: Fysshers and theyr kynne dwelle by the baye.

events.name: The yere of the tempest
events.story: [[Mira]] bryngeth the *Gulle* home thurgh the tempest.

events.name: The olde chartes be founde
events.story: [[Tobin]] fyndeth chartes that none may rede.

modules.name: Wanderynges
modules.description: A Wanderer setteth happenynges upon a mappe, that thou mayst see where thynges befelle and in what ordre.

modules.name: The Metynge
modules.description: A Narrator holdeth speches upon a borde. A speche may offre chesynges; a chesyng may hange upon a token of the tale. The Reader vyewe pleyeth it thurgh.

talks.speaker: Tobin
talks.text: The chartes wolde not lete me goon.

talks.speaker: Sela
talks.text: If we sayle tonyght, none shal aske.

modules.name: The Fyrste Booke
modules.description: An Author Parte is a booke: chapiters on the lefte, the wrytyng table on the ryght. The Board vyewe is a borde of corke with eche chapiters somme, estate and poynt of vyewe.

chapters.name: The kaye
chapters.content: The tyde had turned ere [[Tobin]] came downe the kaye.

chapters.name: The chartes
chapters.synopsis: The chartes shewe a coste that none knoweth.

modules.name: Notes of the Sittynge
modules.description: A Scribe is notes after the manere of speche: shorte lynes with the houre they were wryten. Goode for a sittynge of pleye or a dayes thoughtes.

sessions.name: The fyrste sittynge
messages: The pleyers mette [[Sela]] at the fysshe markette.
They acorded to sayle by nyght.

modules.name: Rumoures
modules.description: A Diviner casteth upon tables of chaunce. A table may use dyse (1d6) or weightes, and a rowe may caste anothir table.

entries.text: A shippe came in with no maryners.
The keper of the lyghthous hath a gest.

modules.name: Draught of the Havene
modules.description: A Sketcher is a borde for drawynge by hande. A panell of pictures in a Designer may shewe one of its leves.

modules.name: Plotte of the Tale
modules.description: A Designer is a free figure. Adde shapes, knytte them, and lynke a shape to any thynge.

modules.name: Of Mira
modules.description: An Inspector is one leef of one thynge. This one is of [[Mira]]: wryte freely, with [[lynkes]] as in any othir place.
